This regulation establishes standards for developing and implementing administrative, technical and physical safeguards to protect the security, confidentiality and integrity of customer information, pursuant to Sections 501, 505(b), and 507 of the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, codified at 15 U.S.C.

Section 501(a) provides that it is the policy of the Congress that each financial institution has an affirmative and continuing obligation to respect the privacy of its customers and to protect the security and confidentiality of those customers’ nonpublic personal information. 

Section 501(b) requires the state insurance regulatory authorities to establish appropriate standards relating to administrative, technical and physical safeguards: (1) to ensure the security and confidentiality of customer records and information; (2) to protect against any anticipated threats or hazards to the security or integrity of such records; and (3) to protect against unauthorized access to or use of records or information that could result in substantial harm or inconvenience to a customer.
C.
Section 505(b)(2) calls on state insurance regulatory authorities to implement the standards prescribed under Section 501(b) by regulation with respect to persons engaged in providing insurance.
D.

Section 507 provides, among other things, that a state regulation may afford persons greater privacy protections than those provided by subtitle A of Title V of the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act. 

This regulation requires that the safeguards established pursuant to this regulation shall apply to nonpublic personal information, including nonpublic personal financial information and nonpublic personal health information.

Protect against any anticipated threats or hazards to the security or integrity of the information; and C.
Protect against unauthorized access to or use of the information that could result in substantial harm or inconvenience to any customer.

quote: Article 101.- Institutions may enter into transactions for the purchase or sale of Foreign Currency against Mexican pesos or against other Foreign Currencies. Additionally, Commercial Banks may enter into transactions for the purchase, sale and swap of Precious Metals.

quote: Foreign Currency purchase and sale transactions entered into by Institutions, as well as the Precious Metal purchase and sale transactions entered into by Commercial Banks, the payment date of which is more the fourth International Banking Business Day as from the date they are entered into, must comply with the general provisions that the Bank of Mexico issues with regard derivative transactions.
prefix: POL785-TRANSACTIONS WITH FOREIGN CURRENCIES AND PRECIOUS METALS, AS WELL AS DERIVATIVES CHAPTER V

dsName: POL786-TRANSACTIONS WITH FOREIGN CURRENCIES AND PRECIOUS METALS, AS WELL AS DERIVATIVES CHAPTER V

quote: Institutions must also inform the exchange rates or maximum sale or minimum purchase prices at which they are willing to enter into the transactions referred to, through posters or notice boards placed by the windows or counters of their branches that clearly show exchange rates and prices at which they enter into transactions, although these posters and notice boards may be placed in other parts of their branches.

prefix: POL791-TRANSACTIONS WITH FOREIGN CURRENCIES AND PRECIOUS METALS, AS WELL AS DERIVATIVES CHAPTER V

quote: Article 105.- Branches Overseas must enter into their transactions as established herein, in other regulations of the Bank of Mexico, and in the laws and regulations of the countries in which they operate, and must not enter into the transactions that are prohibited by the Credit Institutions Law and the provisions that emanate therefrom.

quote: If an Institution has a balance of less than zero on any Day, the Bank of Mexico shall debit to said account the Banking Business Day after the balance of the account drops to less than zero, a sum arrived at by multiplying the negative balance by twice the weighted bank funding rate established by the Bank of Mexico on the Day on which the overdraft occurs, divided by three hundred and sixty.

dsName: POL860-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: Bank of Mexico shall segregate the funds transferred no later than 15:00:00 on the Banking Business Day before the effective date of the transaction. If there is an insufficient balance in the Account in US Dollars on said Banking Business Day to cover the transaction, the Bank of Mexico will cancel the transaction.
prefix: POL860-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL861-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: Institutions must deposit the US Dollars agreed to with the branch nominated by the Bank of Mexico, on the effective date.
prefix: POL861-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL862-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: Bank of Mexico must be advised of the details of accounts for transfers of US Dollars at least five Banking Business Days before the date on which the transfer is to be requested.
prefix: POL862-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL863-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: Article 130.- Bank of Mexico will charge the Institutions a commission of 0.05 to the thousand on each amount of US Dollars transferred, on the understanding that commission may be no less than ten and no more than fifty US Dollars. Commission shall be debited to the Sole Account of the Institution on the effective date of the transaction, at the exchange rate that the Bank of Mexico publishes in the Official Gazette of the Federation the Day before the effective date.
prefix: POL863-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL864-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: The Bank of Mexico will credit the sum to the Account in US Dollars of the Institution in question on the effective date and once it has proof that US Dollars have been received.
prefix: POL864-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL865-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: The Institutions must confirm requests for receiving US Dollars no later than 17:00:00 on the Day the transaction is completed, by sending a SWIFT message, or over any other electronic, computer or telecommunications medium that the Bank of Mexico authorizes, or by letter sent to the Office of Library Services, with signatures first having been registered with the Bank of Mexico.
prefix: POL865-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL866-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: Article 127.- When there is any delay, error or omission of the Institution or its financial agents that has as consequence that the US Dollars are not delivered on time to the accounts of the correspondent banking of Bank of Mexico, the latter shall not credit the Account in US Dollars it holds for the Institution. When the Institution rectifies its error, Bank of Mexico shall credit the correct amount of the transaction to the Account in US Dollars.
prefix: POL866-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL867-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: If the error persists after three International Banking Business Days, the Bank of Mexico may cancel or renegotiate the transaction.
prefix: POL867-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL868-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: The Bank of Mexico debit from the Account in US Dollars any cost it incurs for any such delay, error or omission.
prefix: POL868-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL869-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: Article 128.- Institutions may request Bank of Mexico to transfer funds from their Account in US Dollars to the Accounts in US Dollars that other Institutions have in Bank of Mexico, with an effective date on the same Banking Business Day. The request shall be sent over SIAC-BANXICO between 08:00:00 to16:30:00.
prefix: POL869-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL86-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION
quote: Article 162.- | Agreement to execute credit or repo transactions
prefix: POL86-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION

dsName: POL870-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: If the Account in US Dollars of the Institution requesting the transfer does not have sufficient funds on the effective date, the Bank of Mexico will cancel the transaction.
prefix: POL870-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL871-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO
quote: Article 129.- Institutions may send a request to the Bank of Mexico over the SIAC- BANXICO one or two Banking Business Days before the effective date of the transaction in question, to send US Dollars to their correspondent banking abroad and debit the sum from their Account in US Dollars. Transfers required with one Banking Business Days’ notice may be requested between 08:00:00 to 13:00:00. Transfers required with two Banking Business Days’ notice may be requested between 08:30:00 to 14:30:00.
prefix: POL871-CHAPTER II TRANSACTIONS IN THE ACCOUNTS AT THE BANK OF MEXICO

dsName: POL872-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 131.- The Institutions may enter into repos with the Bank of Mexico in order to obtain liquidity, as follows:
prefix: POL872-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL873-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 133.- Institutions that wish to enter into repos must send their request to Bank of Mexico over the RSP Module, as established in the RSP Manual, specifying the number and characteristics of securities to be repurchased. These transactions shall not be subject to the prohibition of entering into repos as sellers on securities with a fixed yield rate and a term of more than one year, and on securities at a rate that may be reviewed periodically, with a term longer than one calendar year, between the dates on which the rate is reviewed, as established in the repo provisions of the Bank of Mexico.
prefix: POL873-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL874-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: I. Buyer: Bank of Mexico;
prefix: POL874-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL875-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Bank of Mexico will send instructions over the RSP Module to a securities depository institution, so that it may transfer the securities needed to fulfill the repos requested, under the terms of its internal regulations. Sellers must inform Bank of Mexico, over the module, if the funds of the repo are to be credited to their Sole Account held with Bank of Mexico, or in the account they hold with the securities depository institution.
prefix: POL875-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL876-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 134.- The amount of repos that each Institution may enter into with the Bank of Mexico may not exceed the sum arrived at by multiplying the sum calculated as per Annex 9 hereof, by 4.5, and subtracting the sum of its monetary regulation deposits.
prefix: POL876-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL877-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: If the difference is less than or equal to zero, the Institution may not enter into repos over the RSP Module.
prefix: POL877-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL878-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The above limit may only be exceeded by:
prefix: POL878-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL879-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: I. Any adjustment made to the price and the premium with regard to automatic renewals of transactions, in accordance with article 136 hereof;
prefix: POL879-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL87-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION
quote: Article 163.- | Interest Rate
prefix: POL87-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION

dsName: POL880-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: II. Repos that securities firms have abandoned in favor of the Institution that has given them the authorization established in article 141 hereof, and
prefix: POL880-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL881-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: III. Other transactions that the Bank of Mexico orders over the RSP Module, in accordance with applicable provisions, on behalf of the respective Institution.
prefix: POL881-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL882-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 135.- The Institutions may wholly or partly settle repos at any time of the Day during the normal working hours of the RSP Module, in accordance with the RSP Manual. To do so, they must inform Bank of Mexico if the funds needed to pay will be deposited in the account they hold with the securities depository institution or in their Sole Account, and specify the number and characteristics of the securities to be repurchased.
prefix: POL882-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL883-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The repos entered into with these securities shall be settled in the order in which they were entered into, until the number of securities requested has been paid up. Bank of Mexico will send to the securities depository institution, instructions to transfer securities and, if any, cash.
prefix: POL883-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL884-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: If there are transactions missing to be settled when the RSP Module closes, or if they have only been partially settled, Bank of Mexico will consider them as abandoned or it will renew them automatically for the amount remaining, as next article establishes.
prefix: POL884-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL885-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: II. Seller: the Institution;
prefix: POL885-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL886-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The interests that the securities accrue during the effective term of the transactions automatically renewed, will be credited by Bank of Mexico to the Sole Account of the seller on the Day the issuer pays them.
prefix: POL886-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL887-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 136.- If the seller does not pay the price and the premium at due date, the repo shall be considered as abandoned or the obligations shall be considered as automatically novated, as follows:
prefix: POL887-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL888-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: I. The transactions in which the securities subject of the repo expire the next Banking Business Day shall be considered as abandoned. In such case, said securities and their accessory charges will be considered as property of the Bank of Mexico.
prefix: POL888-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL889-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: II. The transactions other than those referred to in the preceding paragraph shall be renewed automatically. Automatic renewal shall begin at the close of business of the RSP Module for the Institutions on the same Day they were entered into, and shall conclude at the end of business of the RSP Module the following Banking Business Day.
prefix: POL889-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL88-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION
quote: Article 15.- | Withdrawal of resources
prefix: POL88-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION

dsName: POL890-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The price of the new transactions shall be calculated according to the value of the securities subject of the repo at the close of the RSP Module on the Banking Business Day on which the renewal begins and shall have the same value of said securities upon the opening of the module the next Banking Business Day. The premium shall be that which the Bank of Mexico determines over the RSP Module.
prefix: POL890-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL891-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The repo securities and the cash of the price and the premium transferred in repos subject to renewal, shall be taken into account for new transactions, and the seller may only have to pay Bank of Mexico, or vice versa, the sums they are due to receive according to the price and premium of the new repos.
prefix: POL891-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL892-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: With regard to automatic renewals, the respective transactions shall be calculated within the limit that applies to the Institution, determined in accordance with article 134 hereof, as from when the RSP Module opens on the Banking Business Day after that on which renewal commences.
prefix: POL892-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL893-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Repeated renewal of repos shall not be considered as a good banking practice, so when the Bank of Mexico realizes that an Institution has automatically renewed repos during the consecutive number of Days that the Bank of Mexico notifies over the RSP Module, it will not renew the repos and will declare them as abandoned when they expire.
prefix: POL893-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL894-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 137.- In case of automatically renewed repos, the Bank of Mexico shall charge the seller the sum that it notifies over the RSP Module, for each issue of repurchased securities.
prefix: POL894-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL895-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: If applicable, it shall also charge the seller the sum arrived at by multiplying the base amount calculated in the manner explained in the paragraphs below, by the result of multiplying the rate for negative balances in the Sole Account, in accordance with article 113 hereof, by the term of the repo and dividing it by three hundred and sixty.
prefix: POL895-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL896-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: III. Term: the time elapsed between the repo is entered into and the close of business, for the Institutions, of the RSP Module on the same Day, with no possibility of extension. The opening and closing times of the module may be found in the RSP Manual;
prefix: POL896-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL897-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The base amount shall be calculated by subtracting the positive balance of the Sole Account at the close from the amount of the renewed repo. If the result is negative, the charge shall not apply.
prefix: POL897-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL898-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: If the balance of the Sole Account is negative at the close, the base amount shall be that of the renewed repos.
prefix: POL898-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL899-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 138.- The Bank of Mexico shall credit or debit the sums arrived at as per section II of article 136 hereof, and those arrived at as per the preceding paragraph, to or from the Sole Account that the seller holds. Said debits or credits will be made at the opening of SIAC-BANXICO the following Banking Business Day after the expiration of the renewed repos.
prefix: POL899-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL89-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION
quote: Article 164.- | Request to participate
prefix: POL89-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION

dsName: POL8-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION
quote: Article 1.- | Subjects
prefix: POL8-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION

dsName: POL900-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The Bank of Mexico will allow the Institutions to overdraw their Sole Accounts, with the abovementioned charges, regardless they are not guaranteed.
prefix: POL900-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL901-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: IV. Securities repurchased: a) BONDES; b) Securities of the IPAB; c) BREMS; d) CETES, excluding Special CETES, and e) Segregated Coupons that are the property of the Institution in question;
prefix: POL901-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL902-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: V. Price: the sum of money that the Bank of Mexico pays the seller under the repo, equivalent to the value of the securities repurchased calculated using the procedure referred to in Annex 7 hereto, less the discount that the Bank of Mexico establishes, depending on the type of security, using the formula and the parameters established in the RSP Manual and the RSP Module, respectively, and
prefix: POL902-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL903-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: VI. Premium: That established by Bank of Mexico through the RSP Module.
prefix: POL903-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL904-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 132.- To be able to enter into the repos referred to herein, Institutions interested must sign an agreement with the Bank of Mexico. To this end, they must submit to the Operations Implementation Division a certified and uncertified copy of the public document that evidences the powers of attorney for acts of ownership of the person who will sign the agreement, plus an uncertified copy of his identification. Additionally, they must submit to the Payment Systems Operation and Business Continuity Division, a power of attorney in the name of the Bank of Mexico, under the terms of Annex 8, signed by the person who has the aforementioned powers.
prefix: POL904-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL905-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The documents referred to above must be submitted at least ten Banking Business Days before the date on which the repos will be entered into. In any case, the agreement must be signed at least five Banking Business Days before this date.
prefix: POL905-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL906-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Institutions must send a copy of the above power of attorney to the relevant securities depository institution.
prefix: POL906-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL907-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 139.- Institutions shall be subject to a limit in addition to those established in article 134 above when entering into repos with securities firms, which comprises not exceeding the figure arrived at by multiplying the sum calculated as per Annex 9 hereof, by 1.4.
prefix: POL907-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL908-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 143.- The Institutions, through the securities firm that represent them, may ask the Bank of Mexico at any time during the time the RSP Module is open for securities firms, as established in the RSP Manual, to settle the repos.
prefix: POL908-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL909-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 140.- Institutions shall act as buyers and securities firms shall act as sellers in repos. These transactions must be formalized by framework agreements that the parties agree. In all cases, Institutions must establish identical characteristics as those of the repos entered into between the Institutions as sellers and the Bank of Mexico as buyer, under the terms of Section of this Chapter, and both repos must be recorded successively in the RSP Module.
prefix: POL909-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL90-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION
quote: Article 165.- | Quotations obtained via electronic means
prefix: POL90-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION

dsName: POL910-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The Institutions must inform to the Bank of Mexico if the funds needed for settlement will be deposited in the account that the securities firms hold with the securities depository institution, or in the account that the securities firms have with the Bank of Mexico, and specify the number and nature of if the securities subject of the repo and the name of the Institution performing the transaction as buyer.
prefix: POL910-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL911-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Repos conducted with said securities will be settled wholly or partly in the order in which they were entered into, until the number of securities requested is covered.
prefix: POL911-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL912-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The Bank of Mexico will send the securities depository institution instructions for transferring securities and cash, if any.
prefix: POL912-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL913-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 144.- When securities firms have repos with the Institutions that have not been paid at the close of the RSP Module for securities firms, they shall be considered as abandoned in favor of these Institutions.
prefix: POL913-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL914-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: In this case, the Institutions may settle the repos entered into with the Bank of Mexico on the securities subject of the repo, before the Institutions closing time at the RSP Module, otherwise repos shall be considered as abandoned or automatically renewed, as applicable, under the terms of article 136 hereof.
prefix: POL914-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL915-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 145.- If an Institution does not have sufficient funds to settle the amount of Government Securities that:
prefix: POL915-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL916-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: I. Have been allocated to it on the primary market under the terms of the “Rules for Auctions for Placement of Government Securities and of Securities of the IPAB” or the “Rules for the Syndicated Auctions of Government Securities”;
prefix: POL916-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL917-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: II. It is obliged to receive derived from the transactions entered into under the terms of the “Rules for Auctions to Purchase Monetary Regulation Bonds and Government Securities Conducted by the Bank of Mexico”, or
prefix: POL917-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL918-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: III. Have been sold to it for exercising of the right of purchase when they operate as market makers on said securities, under the terms of the provisions of the Secretariat of Finance and Public Credit.
prefix: POL918-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL919-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The Bank of Mexico shall proceed as follows:
prefix: POL919-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL91-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION
quote: Article 166.- | Calculation of the exchange rate obtained electronically
prefix: POL91-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION

dsName: POL920-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Institutions shall ensure that the transactions they enter into with securities firms and the agreements they sign strictly observe the provisions of this article and other applicable provisions.
prefix: POL920-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL921-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: I. It will send instructions over the SAGAPL to enter into a repo on behalf of the Institution for the missing amount;
prefix: POL921-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL922-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: II. It will debit from the Sole Account of the Institution the sum that comprises the difference between the amount at which the securities subject of the repo were allocated and the price of the repo. In this case, Institutions may incur in overdrafts without guarantees, in accordance with article 116 hereof;
prefix: POL922-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL923-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: III. It may retain as buyer the Government Securities allocated, and
prefix: POL923-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL924-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: IV. It may use the amount debited to the Sole Account and the funds of the price of the repo to pay the transaction in question.
prefix: POL924-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL925-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: In order that the Institution may enter into the repo referred to in section I above, it must send a power of attorney in the name of the Bank of Mexico, to the Central Bank Back-office Division, using the form attached hereto as Annex 10, signed by the person who has the power to exercise acts of ownership, together with a certified and simple copy of the public document that evidences said power, plus a simple copy of his or her identification. These documents must be submitted within ten Banking Business Days before the date on which the repos are to be entered into. The Institution in question may send a copy of the power of attorney to the securities depository institution.
prefix: POL925-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL926-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 141.- The Institutions that wish to enter into repos with securities firms must notify the Bank of Mexico over the RSP Module, the limit up to which they authorize each security firm to enter into repos.
prefix: POL926-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL927-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: The total of the limits referred to in the preceding paragraph that the Institutions grant the same securities firm, and the total amount of the repos referred to in paragraph two of the article below, entered into by one securities firm, may not exceed five times the global capital of said securities firm.
prefix: POL927-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL928-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Institutions may reduce or cancel the limit authorized for securities firms at any time within the working hours of the RSP Module. Without detriment to this, Institutions shall be obliged to perform the repos entered into by the securities firms that they have authorized to act on their behalf during the effective term of the authorization.
prefix: POL928-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL929-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS
quote: Article 142.- Based on the limits referred to in the preceding article, Institutions may ask the Bank of Mexico, through securities firms authorized to act on their behalf, to enter into repos within the times and under the terms established in the RSP Manual. These transactions shall not be subject to the prohibition of entering into repos as sellers on securities with a fixed yield rate and a term of more than one year, and on securities at a rate that may be reviewed periodically, with a term longer than one calendar year, between the dates on which the rate is reviewed, as established in the repos provisions of the Bank of Mexico.
prefix: POL929-CHAPTER III REPOS TO PROVIDE LIQUIDITY TO PAYMENT SYSTEMS

dsName: POL92-PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AND RURAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION
quote: Article 167.- | Quotations requested to Institutions

quote: Article 157.- The Bank of Mexico will allow those accredited Commercial Banks to accelerate the credit or repo transactions they have executed provided that new credit and/or repo transactions are made. In any case, the new transactions must be made in the amount of the accelerated transaction and shall have the same interest rate or premium, and expiration date.
prefix: POL985-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS

dsName: POL986-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS
quote: Article 158.- If a Commercial Bank does not have enough deposits or securities to guarantee or to enter into credit and/or repo transactions for the total amount of the credit that has been given, the Bank of Mexico will deposit the amount for which it has not been possible to formalize the credit and/or repo transactions until the corresponding guarantees are given. The aforementioned Commercial Bank may pay the outstanding credit and/or repo transactions on any Banking Business Day following notification.
prefix: POL986-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS

dsName: POL987-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS
quote: The Bank of Mexico will charge in the Sole Account of said Commercial Bank, the amount obtained by applying to the amount for which the credit and/or repo transactions have not been formalized, the interest rate corresponding to the number Days of default.
prefix: POL987-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS

dsName: POL988-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS
quote: Article 159.- On the Banking Business Day immediately following the submission of quotations, the Bank of Mexico will charge the appropriate amount of the corresponding deposit in the Sole Account for Commercial Bank which has to make the deposit. If the Commercial Bank does not have sufficient resources, the provisions of Section I of Article 116 hereof shall apply.
prefix: POL988-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS

dsName: POL989-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS
quote: Article 153.- The Bank of Mexico will try to enter into the credit and/or repo transactions up to the total amount of the credits allocated in the schedules established in the SAGAPL manual, which will be available through such system. To this end, the abovementioned credit will be first formalized through credit transactions, and then if necessary, through repos.
prefix: POL989-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS

quote: The interest rate to be accrued by deposits created by Commercial Banks shall be equal to the interest rate that the Commercial Bank in question has quoted, plus the spread that Bank of Mexico had published under the second paragraph of Article 151 of these Provisions.
prefix: POL990-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS

dsName: POL991-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS
quote: The deposits made by the Commercial Bank shall be subject to the time of their creation as collateral for overdrafts in the Sole Account of the depositor Commercial Bank.
prefix: POL991-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS

dsName: POL992-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS
quote: During the term of the aforementioned deposits, the Commercial Bank may direct through SAGAPL that the deposit or part thereof that is not guaranteeing an overdraft of those mentioned in the previous paragraph, is used to secure the financing under this section, or to be granted under the Deposit Auctions, set forth in these Regulations.
prefix: POL992-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS

dsName: POL993-CHAPTER IV DETERMINING THE INTER-BANKING EQUILIBRIUM INTEREST RATE IN MEXICAN PESOS
quote: On the due date of each of the deposits, Bank of Mexico will make the payment for the principal and interest amount of the relevant deposit in the Sole Account of the Commercial Bank that made said deposit, which will stop guaranteeing overdrafts in the Sole Account of the Institution.
